title: Object Creation and Method Calls

lines.explanation: The code before the equal sign are all variable declarations that associate a variable name with an object type. The new keyword is a Java operator that creates the object. The new operator is followed by a call to a constructor, which initializes the new object.
This line of code creates an object of class Rectangle and assigns it to the variable 'rectOne'. myPoint object is used as one of the parameters to specisfy the origin of the rectangle
Another object of class Rectangle is created
To print the width of rectOne we invoke method getWdith() on the object rectOne and print the result.
Similar for the height of this rectangle - we call the method getHeight() for it and display the result
This line prints the area of rectOne

Unlike three previous methods that we used only to retrieve the data of an object, this method changes the object data. This is a mutator method. It moves rectTwo by modifying the x and y coordinates of its origin.

This method prints the X coordinate of rectTwo's origin. We invoke method getOrigin() on rectTwo() to get an access to the Point object that stores rectTwo's origin and then we invoke getX() method on the retrieved Point object to obtain the X coordinate of the origin.
Similar to print the Y coordinate of rectTwo's origin.
